You see a brass-shod chest.

Location

Many around Falcon Bastion, Cobra Bastion, Bounac and Iksupan, 5 around Thais, one in Old Masonry and one on small island near Rascacoon.

Notes

There are few variations of this chest, each containing different valuables or quest items.

Known Brass-Shod Chests types are:

Falcon Bastion

Chests can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • Roasted Dragon Wings
  • Patch of Fine Cloth
  • Falcon Crest
  • Gold Ingot
  • Death Ring
  • Life Ring
  • 10 Platinum Coins

Cobra Bastion

Chests can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • Banana Chocolate Shake
  • Cobra Crest
  • Gold Ingot
  • Death Ring
  • Life Ring
  • 8 Platinum Coins

Lion Bastion

Chests can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • Banana Chocolate Shake
  • Lion Crest
  • Gold Ingot
  • Death Ring
  • Life Ring
  • 8 Platinum Coins
  • 10 Platinum Coins

Iksupan

9 Chests can be found here (33972, 31906, 8), here (33981, 31761, 8), here (34023, 31824, 9), here (34074, 31824, 9), here (34019, 31830, 10), here (34007, 31616, 10), here (34014, 31570, 10), here (34076, 31529, 10), and here (34047, 31483, 11). they can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • 3 Gold Nuggets
  • Bar of Gold
  • Gold Ingot
  • Yellow Gem
  • Life Ring
  • Golden Mug

Old Masonry

Chest located here (32829, 31690, 9) can be opened once every 24h and always gives:

  • 5 Flasks of Embalming Fluid.

Rascacoon

Chest located here (33926, 31363, 7) can be accessed after completing the Journey mission and can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • Tiara
  • Giant Shimmering Pearl (Brown)
  • Blue Gem
  • White Gem
  • Giant Sapphire
  • more?

Andrew Lyze's Chest

Accesible during Unsafe Release mission after using Violet Charged Compass Can be opened once every 20h to get one of the following:

  • 3 Violet Gems
  • 9 Gold Ingots
  • Bar of Gold
  • Dragon Figurine
  • Giant Emerald
  • Buried Cathedral Chest in the room opened with Key 3200. Contains:
  • ?

Oskayaat

Has 5 chests around the island. here (32992, 32939, 2), here (33003, 32923, 2), here (32970, 32984, 7), One in the Feral Werecrocodile Tower north of the depot abd another near the Niral only during the full moon. Contains one of the following every 20? hours:

  • 2 Red Crystal Fragments
  • 2 Tiger Eyes
  • 6 Platinum Coins
  • 1 Golden Sun Coin

Using Brass-Shod Chest, 28 trials.

See also: Brass-Shod Chest.

Newhaven

Has 2 chests in the Corrupted Mines, they can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • Floor 0: here (32572, 32436, 7)
    • 15 Gold Coins
    • 2 White Mushrooms
    • 2 Health Potions
    • 2-3 Mana Potions
  • Floor 1: here (32592, 32434, 6)
    • 3 Health Potions
    • 3 Mana Potions
    • Red Backpack
    • Stealth Ring

Thais Wolf Den

Chests can be opened once every 24h to get one of the following:

  • Floor -1: here (32542, 32237, 8)
    • 2 Health Potions
  • Floor -2: here (32567, 32158, 9)
    • 2 Health Potions

Thais

Chests can be opened only once per character and contain a Heavy Old Tome.

Grimvale Quest

Located north of Heliodor. It is part of the Grimvale Quest. Contains Heliodor's Scrolls.

Forgotten Knowledge Quest

The Chests are located in Ancient Temple (here (32348, 32194, 9)), White Flower Temple (here (32383, 32368, 9)), Mount Sternum Outlook Tower (here (32449, 32109, 8)), south of Greenshore (here (32287, 32118, 7)), Witch house west of Kazordoon (here (32391, 31998, 6))

Isle of Ada

Has 13 chests around the island. Bear (33880, 32210, 4), Adlerauge (33864, 32168, 2), Herald (33827, 32181, 7), tree (33828, 32192, 6), Harpy nest (accessible at night time only) (33825, 32250, 5), east boat (33923, 32130, 7), mines (33884, 32141, 7), south of the Bastion (33880, 32135, 4), planks (33875, 32134, 2), bedroom (33858, 32102, 3), church (33870, 32099, 4), gold hoard (33859, 32104, 5), underground (33794, 32174, 8).

Contains one of the following every 20 hours:

  • 100 Gold Coins
  • 10 Platinum Coins
  • 15 Platinum Coins
  • 25 Platinum Coins
  • 40 Platinum Coins
  • 50 Platinum Coins
  • 65 Platinum Coins
  • Battle Hammer
  • Bottle of Raubritter Lager
  • Crystal Coin
  • Falcon Circlet (Silver)
  • Giant Emerald
  • Giant Ruby
  • Giant Sapphire
  • Giant Topaz
  • Gold Ingot
  • Iron Helmet
  • Might Ring
  • Power Ring
  • Red Gem
  • Silver Amulet
  • Stone Skin Amulet
  • Yellow Gem
  • Proficiency Catalyst
  • Key 7772 (only from the Harpy nest (33825, 32250, 5) chest)
  • Greater Proficiency Catalyst
  • Stag Shield Refinement Plans

And possibly others. Also, there is a chance that the chest will turn into a mimic, damaging you instead of giving you an item.
